column1: ## Lab → phenotype-node mapping for the DMD workbench.
## Each row is: a lab key we observe → the mechanism-chain phenotype node it is
## evidence for. The phenotype nodes are the terminal nodes of the biological
## cascade (variant → protein → pathway → cell/tissue → phenotype). Labs are
## the observable projection of those phenotype nodes.
## Curated from DMD clinical trial endpoints (NSAA, 6MWT, TTS), standard
## cardiology (troponin, BNP, LVEF, LGE), respiratory (FVC, PCF), muscle-
## enzyme biochemistry (CK, LDH, aldolase, MRI fat fraction), Dp260/retinal
## Multiple labs can point to the same phenotype (they corroborate). Multi-
## phenotype labs (LDH — muscle + hemolysis + tumor lysis) are entered
## against their DMD-relevant primary phenotype only.
